_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Jɛnɛ Surround kɔnɔ {width}x{height} kɔlɔn. 
I ni jɛnɛ {player_id}. Kɛlɛɲɛ wɛrɛw: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' wala w/s/a/d.
Kɛlɛɲɛ bɛ jɛnɛ: kɛlɛɲɛ kɛlɛɲɛ bɛɛ kɔnɔ, sɔgɔma bɛ kɔnɔ, jɛnɛ jɛnɛ bɛɛ kɔnɔ.

board.after_moves: Kafo ka yɛlɛmanw bɛɛ kɛ wagati kelen na: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Jurusirabaga {player_id} sara sabu a ka nɛgɛsow tɛ baara kɛ.

outcome.survived_win: Jɛnkɛla {player_id} sɛbɛra; bɛɛ ye jɛnkɛlaw niɲɛ de wɛrɛw.
outcome.all_crashed: U bɛɛ benna o yɔrɔ la wagati kelen na.
outcome.outlived: O tigi ye ɲɛnamaya kɛ fɔɔ ka taga se saya ma.
outcome.turn_limit: Mɔgɔ min tora a sii la ka tɛmɛ fɔlɔ kan, o tigi be se.
